Cast your vote by reacting to this message. You can also discuss below. Information here may be used to construct an IFV.

:tep_for:  = FOR / AYE
:tep_against:  = AGAINST / NAY
:tep_abstain:  = TEP ABSTAINS
:tep_present:  = NO OPINION / PRESENT
Changed the channel name: [NEXT] GA - Restoring Workplace Discrimination Protections

> forbids all employers in member states from discriminating against any individual because of their personal characteristics, except where such discrimination is... conducted by a religious organisation, in the course of hiring that individual to discharge duties directly relating to its religious work, in accordance with its sincerely held religious beliefs,
I brought up this religious exception being a massive loophole in the drafting thread. This version doesn't fix the problem

> to "discriminate against any individual" as refusing to employ any individual, refusing to promote any individual, and removing any individual from their employment,
There's no exception for affirmative action policies

> employing that individual, where they have a personal characteristic and will undertake a role the primary duties of which are directed towards clients sharing that personal characteristic, or
"We're only hiring white people because we have white clients"

> "personal characteristics" as including only age, sex, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, social class, financial or property-owning status, and
Financial or property-owning status. Ay yi yi
This proposal would shift the balance of power to religious organizations. It would incentivize governments to outsource services and functions to religious organizations
Changed the channel name: [AT VOTE - AGAINST] GA - Restoring Workplace Discrimination Protections
"Restoring Workplace Discrimination Protections" was defeated 6,043 votes to 5,135 (45.9% support).
Changed the channel name: [DEFEATED] GA - Restoring Workplace Discrimination Protections
